description:
Application to extend the time limit for implementation of an extant planning permission for the comprehensive redevelopment of site to provide buildings of between 4 and 6 storeys for class B1(a), B1(b) and B1(c) use, with cafe, associated landscaping and car parking (in outline) and conversion and extensions to Gillette Building for use as a hotel, with ancillary conferencing/meeting, bar/restaurant and gym facilities, basement car parking (in detail), provision of new landscaped areas and highway works referenced 00505/AP/P74 dated 22/11/2007. (00505/AP/P75)

Listed Building consent to extend the time limit for implementation of an extant planning permission for works of alteration, extension and demolition to facilitate the retention and conversion of the Gillette Building for hotel use, as part of the proposed comprehensive development of the Gillette site referenced 00505/AP/L22 dated 22/11/2007. (00505/AP/L23)
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - Application for approval of the reserved matters limited to the external appearance of the buildings and the landscaping (hereinafter called "the reserved matters") of that part of the site shaded in blue on drawing no. A-0-PR-1001 (Site Plan Proposed) (hereinafter called "the Business Campus") shall be submitted in writing to the Local Planning Authority within three years of the grant of planning permission.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun either before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission or before the expiration of two years from the date of approval of the last of the reserved matters to be approved, whichever is the later.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application (attached schedule) and the plans submitted therewith or as shall have been otherwise approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the buildings are occupied.

Condition : 4 - Notwithstanding the siting of Building D as shown on drawing no. A-0-PR-1000 (Master Plan Proposed) and specified height AOD of Building D as shown on drawing no.s A-0-PR-1000 and A-0-PR-5000A Rev B (Site Elevations Proposed), applications for the approval of reserved matters relating to Building D buildings shall be accompanied by plans and details of the proposed siting and design of the building.

Condition : 5 - Notwithstanding the siting of Building F as shown on drawing no. A-0-PR-1000 (Master Plan Proposed) and specified height AOD of Building F as shown on drawing no.s A-0-PR-1000 and A-0-PR-5000A Rev B (Site Elevations Proposed), applications for the approval of reserved matters relating to Building F shall be accompanied by plans and details of the proposed siting and design of the building.

Condition : 6 - Within the 86,140sq.m of floorspace (Gross External Area) permitted by this planning permission, with reference to the Town and Planning Use Classes Order as amended by the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) (Amendment) (England) Order 2005,(a)	No more than 47,000sq.m Gross External Area shall be used for any purpose falling within Use Class B1 (Business);(b)	No more than 38,940sq.m Gross External Area shall be used for any purpose falling within Use Class C1 (Hotels); and(c)	No more than 200sq.m Gross External Area shall be used for any purpose falling within Use Class A3 (Restaurants and Caf?s).No additional floorspace shall be formed within the buildings hereby permitted by means of internal horizontal division. For the avoidance of doubt the floorspace limits in paragraphs (a), (b) and (c) shall not be taken to include enclosed areas to be utilised for car parking and cycle parking.
Condition : 7 - The number of bedrooms in the Hotel (that part of the site shaded in yellow on drawing no. A-0-PR-1001 (Site Plan Proposed) (hereinafter called "the Hotel")) shall not exceed 505.

Condition : 8 - Before the development is commenced details of(a)	the works of conversion of the Gillette Building, including making good works following the approved demolition works; (b)	the works of conversion of the Engineers House to the west of the Gillette Building, including making good works; (c)	making good works to the front boundary wall along Syon Lane and its four Victorian cast-iron lamp standards; and(d)	making good works to the boundary wall running down the north-west side of the site unless otherwise approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.  The development shall not be occupied until all the works have been completed as approved.

Condition : 9 - No development shall take place in any phase until a scheme of phasing and timetable of development (including for all hard and soft landscape areas) and timing of construction for the relevant phase has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.  The approved scheme shall be completed and made available for use prior to the occupation of the buildings in the relevant phase and thereafter retained unless otherwise approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 10 - No more than 516 parking spaces shall be provided on site in relation to the development as a whole, comprising a maximum of(a)	214 parking spaces for the Hotel;(b)	300 parking spaces for the Business Campus (the Use Class B1 (Business) and A3 (Restaurants and Caf?s) floorspace) of that part of the site shaded in blue on drawing no. A-0-PR-1001 (Site Plan Proposed); and (c)	two Car Club spaces and such spaces shall be permanently available and not used for any other purpose.

Condition : 11 - No development shall take place in any phase until a scheme identifying and describing the (a) 	location; (b) 	allocation, including of visitor parking and dedicated provision for disabled people; and (c)	timing of provision of the car parking spaces and details of the coach parking and drop off bays as shown on drawing nos. A-0-PR-1002 (Site Circulation Plan Proposed) and A-G-PR-2000 (Lower Ground Floor Plan Proposed) for the relevant phase have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.  The scheme shall include details of directional signage to and within the basement car park for pedestrians and cyclists.  The approved scheme shall thereafter be carried out as approved unless otherwise approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority and the approved car parking and coach parking and drop off bays thereafter retained.

Condition : 12 - No development in any phase shall take place until a scheme for the provision of covered and secure cycle parking spaces, at a ratio of one cycle parking space for every 250m? of gross internal floorspace provided, has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.  The approved scheme shall be completed and made available for use prior to the occupation of the buildings in the relevant phase and thereafter retained.

Condition : 13 - Unless otherwise approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority:(a) 	Vehicle access to the site shall not be otherwise than in accordance with that shown on drawing no. A-0-PR-1002 (Site Circulation Plan Proposed).  (b)	No development shall take place in any phase until details of the relevant means of vehicle access shown on drawing no. A-0-PR-1002 (Site Circulation Plan Proposed), including the internal roads and details of pedestrian access for that phase, have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.  The buildings in the relevant phase shall not be occupied until the relevant means of vehicle access have been completed in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 14 - Before development commences details of sightlines at the points of access to the public highway shall have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority and the development carried out in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 15 - The Hotel shall not be occupied until a Servicing Management Plan for the Hotel use (including details of servicing vehicle access and egress arrangements and timing that servicing shall take place) has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.  The details shall include measures required to ensure sufficient arrangements - physical as well as managerial - for the servicing of the Hotel, the timing of hours for deliveries by motor vehicles and a timetable for implementation.  The Servicing Management Plan shall be carried out as approved unless otherwise approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 16 - No phase of the Business Campus shall be occupied until a Servicing Management Plan for that particular phase (including details of servicing vehicle access and egress arrangements and timing that servicing shall take place) has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.  The details shall include measures required to ensure sufficient arrangements - physical as well as managerial - for the servicing of the Business Campus and the timing of hours for deliveries by motor vehicles - which shall not in any event be given outside the hours of 7am to 8pm nor at any time on Sundays, Bank or Public Holidays - and a timetable for implementation.  The Servicing Management Plan shall be carried out as approved unless otherwise approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 17 - No outside areas shall be used in conjunction with the Class A3 (Restaurant and Caf?s) use located within the Business Campus without the prior written approval of the Local Planning Authority, which shall not in any event be given outside the hours of 7am to 10pm on any day.  Any arrangements should subsequently be retained in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 18 - The Class A3 (Restaurants and Caf?s) use located within the Business Campus shall not be open to customers outside the hours of 07.00 to 12.00am (midnight) on any day of the week unless otherwise approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 19 - No amplified or other music played in or from either the restaurant/bar facility located within the Hotel or from the Class A3 (Restaurants and Caf?s) use located within the Business Campus shall be audible outside of the premises without the prior written approval of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 20 - The Use Class A3 (Restaurants and Caf?s) use hereby permitted shall be confined to sales to customers attending the premises and shall not extend to the delivery of food and/or drink to customers by vehicle unless otherwise approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 21 - No development shall take place until a scheme for the control of fumes and odours from the Hotel use including details of sound attenuation for any necessary plant and a detailed assessment of the effectiveness of the scheme has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.  The scheme once approved shall be implemented before the Hotel use shall commence and be retained thereafter unless otherwise approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 22 - The phase that includes the Class A3 (Restaurant and Caf?) use shall not commence until a scheme for the control of fumes and odours from the caf? including details of sound attenuation for any necessary plant and a detailed assessment of the effectiveness of the scheme has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.  The scheme once approved shall be implemented before the caf? use shall commence and be retained thereafter unless otherwise approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 23 - No development shall take place until a scheme for the investigation and recording of contamination on the site has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority and a report detailing such contamination as has been found, proposals for its removal, containment or otherwise being rendered harmless and measures to verify the adequacy of decontamination work has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.  The approved works of decontamination and verification shall be carried out before development begins or in accordance with a programme approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.  If any contamination not previously identified is encountered during development, whether from a different source or a different type to that addressed in the approved details or in an area expected to have been uncontaminated, then a revised scheme to deal with that contamination, including a programme of work, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority and carried out in accordance with that approval.

Condition : 24 - No development shall take place in any phase until a scheme for the storage and collection of waste and materials to be recycled in that phase (which shall include a waste management strategy for the Hotel) has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority and the approved scheme shall then be managed as approved unless otherwise approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 25 - The conference/function room and restaurant shown on drawing no. A-G-PR-2001 Rev A (Gillette Building Ground Floor Plan Proposed) and the gym facility, fine dining restaurant and bar shown on drawing no. A-G-PR-2002 Rev A (Gillette Building First Floor Plan Proposed) shall be used only as ancillary to the Hotel use hereby permitted and shall not be used for any other purpose.

Condition : 26 - Before any plant and/or machinery is used in any phase it shall have been enclosed with sound-insulating material and mounted in a way which will minimise transmission of structure borne sound in accordance with a scheme for the relevant phase that shall have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 27 - No development shall take place in any phase until detailed drawings and samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces (including eaves details, fascias, windows (notwithstanding Condition 3, including details of window replacement of window frames and glass), balustrades and protective barriers etc and including the materials to be used in the construction of the road surfaces hereby permitted) in the relevant phase have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 28 - No development works shall commence in relation to the Hotel until a scheme indicating the provision to be made for disabled people to gain access to, around and within the Gillette Building and the Engineer's House to the west of the Gillette Building has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.  The scheme shall include details of the 50 rooms that shall be designed for people with disabilities, including their location and the number of occupants they shall cater for.  The approved scheme shall be complied with before the Hotel hereby permitted is occupied and retained.

Condition : 29 - No development works shall commence in relation to the individual phases of the Business Campus (i.e. development within that part of the site shaded in blue on drawing no. A-0-PR-1001 (Site Plan Proposed)) until a scheme indicating the provision to be made for disabled people to gain access to, around and within each building in the relevant phase has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.  The approved scheme shall be complied with in accordance with the approved phasing plan unless otherwise approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority and retained.

Condition : 30 - No development in any phase shall take place until full details of hard landscape works for the relevant phase have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.  Details shall include all hard surfacing materials, proposed finished levels or contours, means of enclosure, vehicle and pedestrian access and circulation areas, minor artefacts and structures (e.g. benches, park structures and ornament, refuse or other storage units, signs including interpretative material, lighting, CCTV, works of art etc.), proposed and existing functional services above and below ground (e.g. drainage, power, communications cables, pipelines etc. indicating lines, manholes, supports etc.), walls, gates and fences.  Details of lighting shall include details of lux levels, direction and screening as well as proposed hours of operation.  All hard landscape work shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details prior to any occupation of buildings within the relevant phase and retained thereafter.

Condition : 31 - No development in any phase shall take place until full details of soft landscape works for the relevant phase have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.  Details shall include proposed finished levels or contours, planting plans, written specifications (including cultivation and other operations associated with plant and grass establishment), plant schedules (noting species, plant sizes and proposed numbers/densities), and tree pits and species proposed to be planted therein and measures to ensure protection from services routes.  All soft landscape works shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details within 12 months of occupation of any buildings within the relevant phase and retained thereafter.

Condition : 32 - If within a period of ten years from the date of planting any tree or specimen shrub, that tree or specimen shrub, or any tree or specimen shrub planted in replacement for it, is removed, uprooted or destroyed or dies (or becomes, in the opinion of the Local Planning Authority, seriously damaged or defective), another tree or specimen shrub of the same species and size as that originally planted shall be planted at the same place, unless the Local Planning Authority gives its written approval to any variation.  (b)	If within a period of ten years from the date of occupation of any phase any existing tree or specimen shrub within the relevant phase which is to be retained in accordance with the approved plans and particulars is removed, uprooted or destroyed or dies (or becomes, in the opinion of the Local Planning Authority, seriously damaged or defective), another tree or specimen shrub shall be planted at the same place and that tree or specimen shrub shall be of such size and species, and shall be planted at such time, as specified in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 33 - No phase of the development shall commence until there has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority a plan indicating the positions, design, materials and type of boundary treatment to be erected for that phase.  No building shall in any event be occupied until the boundary treatment for the relevant phase is completed in accordance with the approved detail and thereafter retained unless otherwise approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 34 - A landscape management plan, including long term design objectives, management responsibilities and maintenance schedules for all hard and soft landscape areas, and details of any temporary landscaping (including boundary treatment) to be provided and management thereof pending the redevelopment of future phases of the development, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to the occupation of each phase of the development unless otherwise approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.  The maintenance schedule shall be for a minimum period of ten years and include details of the arrangements for its implementation.  The landscape management plan shall be carried out as approved unless otherwise approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 35 - No development shall take place until a programme of archaeological work (including a watching brief) and the timetable for the investigation has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.  The approved programme shall be carried out as approved.

Condition : 36 - No building or any part of the development hereby permitted shall exceed the specified height AOD as set out in drawing nos. A-0-PR-1000 (Master Plan Proposed) and A-0-PR-5000A Rev B (Site Elevations Proposed) and no louvers, ducts or other external plant equipment shall be installed on any building without the prior written approval of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 37 - No development shall take place until a Construction Environmental Management Plan (CEMP) covering both the demolition and construction stages has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.  The CEMP shall cover:(a)	Any external illumination of the site;(b)	Any illumination of the interior of buildings prior to their occupation;(c)	Measures to ensure that all mud and other loose materials are not carried on the wheels and chassis of any vehicles leaving the site;(d)	Measures to minimise dust nuisance caused by the operations and to ensure that no dust or other debris is carried on to the adjoining properties;(e)	The routeing of vehicles to the site, access and egress arrangements and waiting areas;(f)	Boundary treatment and measures to ensure they are maintained in a secure and tidy condition; (g)	The contractors compound; (h)	Considerate Contractor Scheme; (i)	Protection of retained trees and specimen shrubs (which shall include measures in accordance with BS5837: 2005);(j)	A scheme, including a method statement, to ensure the Gillette Building and the Engineer's House to the west of the Gillette Building are protected during the approved demolition and construction works; and(k)	Any other measures that shall be implemented to regulate the environmental impact of the construction process.The development shall thereafter be implemented in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 38 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8am to 6pm on Mondays to Friday and 9am to 1pm on Saturdays and not at all on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior written approval of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 39 - Development shall not commence until foul and surface water drainage details incorporating the principles of sustainable urban drainage (including green roofs and permeable pavement design) and including a timetable for implementation have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details and retained thereafter.

Condition : 40 - Development shall not commence until impact studies of the existing water supply infrastructure have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The studies shall determine the magnitude of any new additional capacity required in the system and a suitable connection point as well as a timetable for implementation.  The development shall thereafter be implemented in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 41 - Prior to the commencement of each phase of the development, a detailed scheme of on-site sustainability covering:(a)	measures for the harvesting of rainwater and the minimisation of water run-off;(b)	grey water reuse as appropriate; (c)	the sourcing of materials to be used in the construction of and fitting out of the development (involving reuse, recycling and other sustainable sourcing); (d)	the use of passive ventilation; and (e)	any other measures that shall be implemented to regulate the environmental impact of the proposed development including installation of low-water-use appliances, systems and fittings and use of a Building Management System to monitor, control and optimize heating, air conditioning and lightingshall have been prepared in relation to that phase and submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.  The scheme as approved shall be implemented prior to occupation of that phase of the development unless otherwise approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority and retained thereafter.

Condition : 42 - With respect to any condition that requires the prior written approval of the Local Planning Authority the approval may only be taken as having been given if it is given expressly by reference to the relevant condition (and for the avoidance of doubt agreement expressed under Section 106 of the own and Country Planning Act 1990 shall not, alone, be taken as such an approval) and the works thereby approved shall be carried out in accordance with that approval unless subsequently otherwise approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 43 - Development works to provide the Business Campus shall not commence until an assessment of the microclimate (wind) of and around the site, including details of any required mitigation and taking into account any potential impacts arising from phased construction works, has been submitted in writing to the Local Planning Authority.  The approved mitigation measures shall be completed prior to the occupation of any part of the development to which they relate and retained thereafter or as otherwise may have been approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 44 - Notwithstanding Condition 3, not to commence the development until details of,(i) any works to the existing window openings of the Gillette Building including any   secondary glazing; and (ii) any replacement windows (glass and/or frame) within the Gillette Building have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.  All works shall be carried out as approved before the Hotel hereby permitted is occupied and retained thereafter.
Condition : 45 - In relation to the parking provision for the B1 Uses provision for 20% active charging points and 20% passive charging provision shall be provided and maintained thereafter.
